purpose.zh: 加强深层外旋肌，让肩更稳
purpose.en: Strengthen the deep external rotators for steadier shoulders.

text.zh: 肘贴住身体，只让前臂向外打开
text.en: Keep your elbow at your side and rotate only your forearm outward

text.zh: 肘弯90度，肘和身体之间夹一块小垫
text.en: Bend your elbow to 90 degrees with a small pad between elbow and ribs.
Return over three seconds without shrugging.

commonErrors.en: Turning the body instead of the shoulder.
Letting the elbow leave your side.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减轻阻力或减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Use a lighter band or less range if your shoulder hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
